title: Detection of the [O I] 63 µm emission line from the z = 6.04 quasar J2054-0005

recipe.goal: Image the Band 9 dust continuum and measure its flux
recipe.method: tclean continuum image (SPW1,3,4 plus line-free channels), imfit 2D Gaussian for flux density, position and size
imcontsub on SPW2 then tclean cube, 50 km/s channels, no uv-taper, natural weighting
assumptions: Phase-tracking center slightly offset from the quasar, so image-plane continuum subtraction is better than uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Make moment-0 map and extract and fit the spectrum
recipe.method: Integrate 673.96-674.44 GHz (250 km/s), extract the continuum-subtracted spectrum from the 2-sigma aperture, fit a Gaussian for FWHM and z
key_parameters: Spectrum noise measured in 671.3-673.5 GHz and 674.6-676.8 GHz

recipe.goal: Measure [O I] line flux and luminosity
recipe.method: imfit 2D Gaussian on the 500 km/s integrated map, then L_line = 1.04e-3 S dv D_L^2 nu_obs
assumptions: Line region unresolved; size upper limit taken as the continuum size

recipe.goal: Compute luminosity ratios and compare with literature samples
recipe.method: Form L_[OI]/L_FIR and L_[OI]/L_[CII] using literature [C II] and CIGALE-based L_FIR, plot against local, z=1-3 and z>4 samples
key_parameters: Lensing magnification corrected for literature objects
assumptions: SFR converted to L_FIR assuming Salpeter IMF for the local relation

recipe.goal: Assess AGN/XDR contribution to the lines
recipe.method: Compare observed [O I]/[C II] to AGN thresholds in the literature and use the [C II]/[C I](2-1) argument of Decarli et al. 2022
assumptions: Lines assumed to arise from PDRs, not XDRs, for the subsequent modeling

recipe.goal: Constrain gas density and FUV field with PDR models
recipe.method: Compare the [O I]/[C II] and ([C II]+[O I])/L_FIR ratios with PDR Toolbox wk2020 model grid (Z=1.0) after three luminosity corrections
key_parameters: L_FIR(PDR) = 0.22 L_FIR; L_[CII](PDR) = 0.83 L_[CII]; L_[OI] multiplied by 2
assumptions: Plane-parallel PDR geometry; Z/Zsun = 1.0; [C II], [O I] and dust co-spatial; [C II] purely from PDR after removing 17% H II fraction

recipe.goal: Test for [O I] self-absorption with a two-component Gaussian
recipe.method: Fit two Gaussians to the [O I] spectrum, one forced to [C II] center and width with free amplitude, the second unconstrained, compare with [C II]
assumptions: [O I] emission arises in the same regions as [C II]
